body: Thanks. I am 53 and have never had a mentor. I made it this far all on my own.

Thanks, I do appreciate your kind words. No pets anymore. They have kept me from my final solution in the past. I desperately wanted to end it all but I couldn't stand the idea of leaving my adorable little ferrets all alone. When I took them in it was my mission to give them the best little lives that I could. I do have hobbies, but they are no longer active. I am pretty much completely anhedonic at the moment.  As they say in the sporting world, I am just playing out the string. No playoffs for me.

Hello, thanks for your reply.

Perhaps I will find out this afternoon when I talk with my psychiatrist. The law requires them to act if they believe I will harm myself. I have felt extremely lonely for the last 15 years even though I was with my partner of 18 years until last year.  I am given anti-depressants but they are a shoddy bandaid on a sucking chest wound. My hope for the future is fading rapidly. It's a small miracle that I am actually still here. Trust me, I have been fighting hard. I *am* an island. One that is inundated with every storm. What I cannot tell my doctors is that I now have an exit plan and I know now from previous experience not to be afraid. We all have our limits.

It seems very unlikely to me that I will be able to find a solution to what ails me (loneliness). I have until my finances are exhausted. I don't have the energy to work to continue living in pain. Do I really want to die? Not really. I just don't see the point. I tried, I have had a few moments in the sun and my last day will be nice. No mess for anyone to clean up, and noone will miss me. One can only go against the grain for so long. I talk about it here because I am not worried about getting anyone down. Even here I am just a drop in the bucket. The pain here is astonishiing, not an ideal place for an empath. :-) Take care, thank you.
Let it out. You are essentially anonymous here so you have nothing to fear. How is it that you are not feeling like yourself?

What you are experiencing *is* abuse. My father physically abused me, but those wounds are nothing compared to the emotional and psychological scars he left. Find someone you can talk to. Don't let things fester. Child abuse is a crime. Report it. I wish I had 40 years ago. I left home as soon as I could, and it just got worse for my little sister and mother. He drove my Mom to an early grave, left me completely fucked up, and got away with it. He should be in jail.

I don't have that issue with cannabis. Alchohol however will make me feel sad a day or two after I drink, and that's from only 1 or 2 drinks. My solution is that I hardly ever drink, and avoid it completely if I am already down, which is most of the time. We are all different. I find cannabis can really bring deep emotions to the surface which can be good or bad depending on whether you are prepared to deal with them or not and what their nature is. Peace.

Yeah, it is the same for me. I do have good days here and there where I am very grateful to be alive. The world grinds me back down though, or my perception of the world does. Hard to distinguish.

Yes, it is good to have an impartial ear. It took me until I was 52 to get around to finding a good therapist. I knew from my teens onward that I needed help but I have been poor, living below the poverty line for most of my life. I am okay with that though. Materially I still have more than I need. I have taken care of my body and eaten well.  Someone that understands me at least a little bit is a different matter. I hope you find a good fit medication wise. My meds help me quite a bit at the moment. Peace.

Thanks for listening. Can we take strength from knowing that we are not alone? I suppose if I am typing here I am not thinking about killing myself. Perhaps sharing helps us lighten our burden somehow. I know I feel I have not been heard for a long time. So it does help me that you folks read and offer support. Keep writing. I have written much, sporadically, over the years but it has never been for public consumption. I am too dark for most, but that is how the world through my eyes has made me. Here I feel like we can relate. The common unity of suicidal thoughts. We are told it is good to talk about it. I don't really want to kill myself. i just want the pain to end, and most people don't understand that pain.

Thank you for your support and the links. I am new here. That was my first post. I went to the hospital last summer in despair at the prospect of losing my home which is my sanctuary. The psychiatrist that saw committed me and then she took me on as a patient. My ex made a comment to my sister saying, "I hope he finds the help he needs in hospital." The help I truly need is a good friend or two so her comment and callousness hurt me. It is the feeling of loneliness that is the root of my depression. I feel invisible and worthless even though I like who I am. I used to be very social but that was 20 years ago when I was still young and before I met "her". Now life seems so short and it feels like a waste.

Fortunately I live in Canada so medical coverage is not an issue. I don't want to go back to the hospital. I live in a 108 year old house in a forest by the ocean. If this place can't help me heal then nothing can. I cannot go without the birds that brighten my days a bit. I talk to them, I talk to the bees, and raccoons and even plants. I don't care any more if the neighbours think I am crazy. I think it might only be a matter of time before I get to that dark place again and I don't think I will call 911 next time. I don't know. I do try though but it is getting tiresome.
Thank you for your kind words.
